description: Unit tests for the Blazor App component, testing authentication, authorization, routing, and page rendering behavior.

classes.name: AppRenderTests
classes.description: Test class containing multiple unit tests for rendering the App component based on authorization and routing scenarios.

methods.name: App_NotAuthenticated_AdminRoute_Renders_RedirectToLogin
methods.description: Tests if an unauthenticated user navigating to a protected route is redirected to login.

methods.name: App_Authorized_NotInRole_Shows_NotAuthorized_Message
methods.description: Verifies that a user who is authorized but not in the required role sees a 'Not Authorized' message.

methods.name: App_Authorized_AdminRole_Renders_Admin_List_Page
methods.description: Checks that a user with admin role is properly routed and the admin list page content is rendered.

methods.name: App_UnknownRoute_Renders_NotFound_Message
methods.description: Ensures navigating to an undefined route displays a not found message.
